title: The Green field behind the house
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：green　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 green 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the porter wrote of ① a green field behind the house in the journal, and everybody in the coast said at once that it was ② greener than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the porter, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the green ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the greenest field behind the house anybody in the coast had ever seen, or so the journal for August 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too green to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the green ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a green boy in the workshop, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as green as the boy in the workshop they had once had in the old coast. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was green or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something green, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next coast called the whole plan ⑧ quite green; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the green ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, in the rain, she wrote of another green field behind the house in the same journal, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ greener than anybody had expected. ⑩ The greenest boy in the workshop in the whole coast, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the green ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 绿色（前置定语 a green field behind the house：1963 年挑夫在行记里记下的那件绿色的绿地）
B. adj. 绿色／青涩（比较级 greener than：文中两处，一处比屋后的绿地，一处比预想）
C. adj. 绿色／青涩（最高级 the greenest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 绿色（表语 too green to do：母亲觉得它太绿色，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 青涩（前置定语 a green boy in the workshop：叔叔把整件事称作一桩青涩的新手）
F. adj. 青涩（同级比较 as green as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩作坊里的新手相比）
G. adj. 青涩（后置定语 something green：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 青涩（受程度副词修饰 quite green：那位游客的评价）

items.q: a green field behind the house
the greenest field behind the house anybody
a green boy in the workshop
The greenest boy in the workshop in

answers.why: green 意为“绿色”，1963 年挑夫在行记里记下的是“一件绿色的绿地”，此处作前置定语 a green field behind the house。
green 意为“绿色”，此处用比较级 greener than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
green 意为“绿色”，行记上 八月 那行字说它是海岸里最绿色的一件，故用最高级 the greenest field behind the house。
green 意为“绿色”，母亲认为这件东西“太绿色了，谁也用不上”，too green to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
green 意为“青涩”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩青涩的新手”，此处作前置定语 a green boy in the workshop。
green 意为“青涩”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩作坊里的新手一样青涩”，同级比较用 as green as。
green 意为“青涩”，行记上那半行字要的是“青涩的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something green。
green 意为“青涩”，邻海岸来的那位游客认为这套计划“相当青涩”，quite 修饰原级 green。
green 意为“青涩”，1973 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要青涩”，故用比较级 greener than。
green 意为“青涩”，母亲 1975 年说的是“整个海岸里最青涩的那一桩”，故用最高级 the greenest boy in the workshop。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，挑夫在行记里记下了一件绿色的绿地。（a green field behind the house）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更绿色。（greener than …）
母亲觉得它太绿色，谁也用不上。（too green to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩青涩的新手。（a green boy in the workshop）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩作坊里的新手一样青涩。（as green as …）
到了 1970 年，行记上只剩半行字：要的是一件青涩的东西。（something green）
answers: In 1963 the porter wrote of a green field behind the house in the journal.
Everybody said it was greener than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too green to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a green boy in the workshop.
He said nobody would call it as green as the boy in the workshop they had once had.
By 1970 the journal asked for nothing but something green.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 green 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the porter wrote of a green field behind the house in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the greenest field behind the house in the coast, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too green to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a green boy in the workshop, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next coast called the plan quite green, and everybody laughed.
The green ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
